description: Ma trận hồi quy cho dự án web. Lệnh test tự chọn runner theo lockfile (pnpm/yarn/bun/npm); thiếu package.json thì FAIL chứ không coi là PASS.

mandatory_regression_tests.name: Unit/integration tests (package.json test script)
mandatory_regression_tests.command: if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo 'REG-WEB: no package.json in the project root' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm test; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn test; elif [ -f bun.lockb ] || [ -f bun.lock ]; then bun test; else npm test; fi

mandatory_regression_tests.name: TypeScript type-check (tsc --noEmit) when tsconfig.json exists
mandatory_regression_tests.command: if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then npx --no-install tsc --noEmit; else echo 'REG-WEB-02: no tsconfig.json — plain JavaScript project, nothing to type-check'; fi
